lead: S. S. Rajamouli is an Indian film director, born on 10 October 1973 in Manvi.
As of 2026, he is 52 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has 29 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Nandi Award for Best Director and Filmfare Award for Best Director – Telugu.
The sections that follow break down S. S. Rajamouli's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
